notes: All citation fields verified against fetched arXiv/PMLR/ACM/GitHub pages on 2026-09-27 by independent literature-research agents; nothing recorded from memory.
GitHub HEAD commits fetched live from api.github.com or the public commits.atom feed on 2026-09-27.
Formal comparison uses published methods adapted to the AC-Twin task/data/legal-input contract; original-paper numbers on other benchmarks are never copied into AC-Twin result tables.

Correction vs plan draft wording: CCTR's original calibration is a context-conditioned post-processing network (CNN over BEV + GRU + Softplus temperature), not ensemble-based; the P5 adaptation uses five-seed frozen prediction disagreement + legal context as the temperature inputs (adapted implementation, deviation recorded).

Correction vs plan draft wording: Li et al. 2024 (RwR) learns the rejector separately on an independent validation split via kernel/kNN conditional-loss estimation (kNNRej); the P3 adaptation uses in-sample train residuals as the kNN reference because validation is reserved for selection/power only (adaptation deviation recorded).
Deep Gamblers (NeurIPS 2019) is classification-only and explicitly defers regression to future work: kept as positioning literature, not an experimental candidate.

Grid amendment at Task 3 design time (pre-implementation, nothing trained/consumed): P1 depth fixed to 3, P2 hidden grid {64,96}, P5 grid {(64,3),(96,2)} so every grid item's parameter count falls inside the frozen 0.5x-2.0x Direct capacity band [7870, 31480]; the earlier draft grids contained items outside the band that the capacity rule would have excluded anyway.

works.title: How Can Driving World Models Do Counterfactual Prediction?
works.authors: Jiaru Zhang, Can Cui, Yi Xu, et al.
works.original_task: Rung-3 counterfactual prediction with action-conditioned driving world models on a recorded episode.
works.original_inputs: Factual driving log/shared history plus an alternative ego action; observed factual continuation as evidence.
works.original_outputs: Counterfactual future episode completions evaluated against matched simulator ground truth.
works.training_supervision: Training-free 4-stage pipeline (Abduce, Transport, Complete, Combine) on frozen world models.
works.reason: Outputs counterfactual episode completions, not a pre-truth per-action-group scalar risk; adapting it to risk scoring would redefine its research question.

works.title: What-If Motion Prediction for Autonomous Driving
works.authors: Siddhesh Khandelwal, William Qi, Jagjeet Singh, et al.
works.original_task: Long-term multi-agent motion forecasting with injected what-if counterfactual goals/social contexts.
works.original_inputs: Scene context (road lanes), multi-agent tracks, optional counterfactual goals/social contexts at inference.
works.original_outputs: Diverse long-term trajectory forecasts under (possibly hypothetical) conditioning.
works.training_supervision: Supervised trajectory forecasting on logged driving (Argoverse); counterfactual conditioning is inference-time.
works.reason: Trajectory distributions, not group-level decision-risk scores; no 2024+ paper with this title exists (the 2020 WIMP paper is the canonical one).

works.title: Promptable Closed-loop Traffic Simulation
works.authors: Shuhan Tan, Boris Ivanovic, Yuxiao Chen, et al.
works.original_task: Promptable closed-loop traffic simulation steerable by multimodal per-agent prompts.
works.original_inputs: Real driving scenario plus numerical/categorical/textual prompts per agent.
works.original_outputs: Closed-loop multi-agent trajectory rollouts (8 s) consistent with prompts.
works.training_supervision: Supervised imitation on Waymo scenarios with prompt-scenario pairs (ProSim-Instruct-520k).
works.reason: Simulation rollouts, not pre-truth failure-risk scores.

works.title: Estimating counterfactual treatment outcomes over time in complex multiagent scenarios
works.authors: Keisuke Fujii, Koh Takeuchi, Atsushi Kuribayashi, et al.
works.original_task: Individual treatment-effect / counterfactual outcome estimation over time in interacting multiagent systems.
works.original_inputs: Observational multiagent trajectories with time-varying confounders, treatments, outcomes.
works.original_outputs: Counterfactual covariate/outcome trajectories and estimated optimal treatment timing.
works.training_supervision: Factual observational data; GVRNN + domain knowledge + adversarial balancing.
works.reason: Counterfactual outcome trajectories; a group-level action risk score is not native and would require redefining the endpoint.

works.title: CF-GODE: Continuous-Time Causal Inference for Multi-Agent Dynamical Systems
works.authors: Song Jiang, Zijie Huang, Xiao Luo, et al.
works.original_task: Continuous-time counterfactual outcome estimation in multi-agent dynamical systems with interference.
works.original_inputs: Graph-structured multi-unit systems with dynamic treatments, covariates, factual outcomes.
works.original_outputs: Continuous potential-outcome trajectories per unit under alternative treatment sequences.
works.training_supervision: Factual outcomes; outcome-prediction loss + domain-adversarial balancing losses.
works.reason: Per-unit potential-outcome trajectories; group decision-risk score not native.

works.title: Counterfactual Prediction for Outcome-Oriented Treatments
works.authors: Hao Zou, Bo Li, Jiangang Han, et al.
works.original_task: Counterfactual outcome prediction focused on outcome-oriented (superior-outcome) treatments for decision-making.
works.original_inputs: Observational data with (possibly continuous) treatments, covariates, factual outcomes.
works.original_outputs: Reweighted counterfactual outcome predictor optimized for selecting the optimal treatment.
works.training_supervision: Factual outcomes with outcome-oriented sample re-weighting.
works.reason: Changes the action-consequence prediction/selection objective rather than auditing a frozen base selector; reported only in a supplemental decision-focused table if Phase L adaptation proves feasible without changing task/data roles (plan 2.3).

works.title: Factual Observation Based Heterogeneity Learning for Counterfactual Prediction
works.authors: Hao Zou, Haotian Wang, Renzhe Xu, et al.
works.original_task: Counterfactual outcome prediction recovering missing heterogeneity from the factual observation.
works.original_inputs: Observational covariates plus the factual outcome for the unit.
works.training_supervision: Factual observations only; abduction-style use of the factual outcome.
works.reason: Requires the factual outcome as input and emits counterfactual outcomes, not pre-truth action-group risk.

works.title: Addressing Failure Prediction by Learning Model Confidence
works.authors: Charles Corbiere, Nicolas Thome, Avner Bar-Hen, et al.
works.original_task: Failure (misclassification) prediction for image classification / semantic segmentation.
works.original_outputs: Scalar learned confidence in [0,1] per input estimating the True Class Probability (TCP).
works.training_supervision: Auxiliary confidence MLP trained on the frozen classifier's TCP (softmax mass on the true class) with l2 loss; optional later encoder fine-tune.

adaptation.summary: Frozen base selector's ten-action predicted costs J_hat are converted to action probabilities by a train-only/validation-frozen temperature; the oracle action's probability at train time is the TCP supervision; a confidence network reads only legal features; inference risk = 1 - predicted_TCP.
adaptation.formula_source: paper Sec. 3 (TCP target, l2 confidence loss), verified against ar5iv full text
adaptation.training_target: probability the tempered J_hat softmax assigns to the train-time oracle action
deviations_from_original: Inputs are AC-Twin legal decision features instead of image encoder features; classifier confidence (TCP over actions) replaces class TCP.

works.title: Selective Classification for Deep Neural Networks
works.original_task: Selective classification with a guaranteed risk bound (SGR).
works.original_outputs: Confidence rate kappa(x), threshold, certified risk bound.
works.training_supervision: Post-hoc on a trained classifier; binomial-tail threshold search.
works.reason: Post-hoc classification confidence thresholding; AC-Twin's frozen internal baselines already cover confidence-ranking controls, and the experimental slot for learned confidence is P1/P5 per the frozen family table.

works.title: SelectiveNet: A Deep Neural Network with an Integrated Reject Option
works.original_task: End-to-end selective prediction jointly training prediction and rejection (classification; UCI regression variant).
works.original_outputs: Prediction f(x), selection score g(x) (single sigmoid), auxiliary head output.
works.training_supervision: Three heads; loss = selective risk / coverage + lambda * quadratic coverage penalty + auxiliary loss (lambda=32, alpha=0.5).

adaptation.summary: Same legal-feature encoder with regret-regression, selection and auxiliary heads; trained with the paper's selective-risk + coverage penalty + auxiliary loss at target coverage 0.80; risk score = 1 - selection probability; full risk-coverage curve from this score.
adaptation.formula_source: paper Sec. 4 loss (verified against ar5iv full text): selective risk normalized by coverage + lambda*max(0,c-phi)^2 + aux
adaptation.training_target: true selected-action decision regret (train truth only)
deviations_from_original: Regression of decision regret on legal driving features replaces image/tabular prediction; single-task auxiliary head mirrors the paper's regression variant.

works.sanity_evidence: phase_l/sanity/sanity_report.json: SELECTIVENET_REGRET_ADAPTED PASS (coverage=0.800, selective MSE 0.0961 < full 0.1305, Spearman=0.660)

works.title: Deep Gamblers: Learning to Abstain with Portfolio Theory
works.authors: Liu Ziyin, Zhikang T. Wang, Paul Pu Liang, et al.
works.original_task: Selective classification with an (m+1)-th abstention output trained by portfolio doubling rate.
works.training_supervision: Gambler doubling-rate loss; optional cross-entropy pretraining.
works.reason: Classification-only; the paper explicitly defers regression to future work, so it is not a same-endpoint candidate for a decision-regret regression task.

works.title: When No-Rejection Learning is Consistent for Regression with Rejection
works.authors: Xiaocheng Li, Shang Liu, Chunlin Sun, et al.
works.original_task: Regression with rejection: jointly regress and defer at cost to minimize risk plus deferral cost.
works.original_outputs: Scalar regression prediction plus reject indicator; rejector score = estimated conditional loss.
works.training_supervision: No-rejection learning: plain squared loss on ALL training data (consistent under weak realizability); rejector = kernel/kNN (Nadaraya-Watson) estimate of conditional loss learned separately (kNNRej).

adaptation.summary: Main regressor learns true selected-action regret on ALL train groups; rejector estimates local error/difficulty in the frozen learned representation via kNN averaging of reference residuals (kNNRej idea); k chosen from {16,32,64} on validation by lowest AURC.
adaptation.formula_source: paper Algorithm 1 (kNNRej kernel conditional-loss estimation), verified against arXiv v4
adaptation.training_target: true selected-action decision regret (train truth only)
adaptation.risk_output: kNN-averaged reference residual in representation space (higher = riskier)
deviations_from_original: Reference residuals are in-sample train residuals (validation is reserved for selection/power and cannot serve as the rejector reference); kernel weights reduce to uniform kNN average in the frozen representation.

works.sanity_evidence: phase_l/sanity/sanity_report.json: RWR_NN_KNN_REJECT_ADAPTED PASS (Spearman=0.645, kept-80% MSE ratio 0.027)

works.title: Conformal Risk Control
works.authors: Anastasios N. Angelopoulos, Stephen Bates, Adam Fisch, et al.
works.original_task: Control the expected value of any monotone loss at level alpha, distribution-free, via split-conformal-style calibration.
works.original_inputs: Pre-trained model, held-out calibration set, monotone loss, target risk level.
works.original_outputs: Calibrated parameter lambda_hat generating risk-controlling prediction sets.
works.training_supervision: No retraining; calibration-time lambda search with (n+1)-point quantile correction.
works.reason: Outputs a calibrated guarantee, not a per-input risk ranking compatible with a full risk-coverage curve; activates only if P4 fails Phase L compatibility per plan 2.4 (P4 passed sanity, so not activated).

works.title: Conformal Regression with Reject Option
works.authors: Ulf Johansson, Cecilia Sonstrod, Henrik Bostrom
works.original_task: Conformal regression that abstains on instances expected to be inaccurate, trading rejection level against interval width.
works.original_inputs: Tabular regression features (16 datasets); random-forest underlying model.
works.original_outputs: Valid conformal intervals for retained instances plus rejection indicator; interval sizes known before test predictions.
works.training_supervision: Mondrian conformal regression with categories built from per-instance difficulty estimates and the requested rejection level.

adaptation.summary: Regressor predicts group regret on a deterministic 80% fit split (group-seed hash); Mondrian split-conformal on the DISJOINT 20% calibration split with categories from a frozen difficulty rule; risk score = frozen difficulty/interval-width ordering; calibration data never overlaps the comparison holdout.
adaptation.formula_source: paper: Mondrian split-conformal calibration with difficulty-based categories (PMLR v230), no official code exists
adaptation.training_target: true selected-action decision regret (fit split only)
forbidden_at_inference: calibration split membership beyond frozen bin thresholds
deviations_from_original: Neural regressor on AC-Twin legal features replaces random forests on tabular data; difficulty rule frozen from legal strata/prediction features.

works.sanity_evidence: phase_l/sanity/sanity_report.json: CONFORMAL_REGRESSION_REJECT_ADAPTED PASS (marginal coverage=0.894 in [0.85,0.95], width order matches error order, Spearman=0.748)

works.title: CCTR: Calibrating Trajectory Prediction for Uncertainty-Aware Motion Planning in Autonomous Driving
works.authors: Chengtai Cao, Xinhong Chen, Jianping Wang, et al.
works.original_task: Calibrate predictive variance of driving trajectory predictors for safer downstream motion planning.
works.original_inputs: Agent trajectory history + HD-map BEV context + kinematic/social features (Argoverse 1).
works.original_outputs: Per-sample per-timestep temperature ratios rescaling predicted variances.
works.training_supervision: Two-stage: NLL + calibration regularizer during predictor training; small post-processing net trained on validation NLL for sample-specific temperature.

adaptation.summary: Five-seed frozen action-consequence prediction disagreement plus legal context/history features feed a sample-specific temperature model calibrating action-consequence uncertainty; group risk = calibrated uncertainty of the selected action's consequence. May read frozen five-seed predictions; never counterfactual truth.
adaptation.formula_source: paper: NLL-trained sample-specific temperature (Softplus-positive) — original uses a CNN/GRU post-net, not ensembles (deviation below)
adaptation.training_target: train-truth selected-action regret / consequence error under temperature-rescaled NLL
deviations_from_original: Original CCTR computes temperature from a CNN-over-BEV + GRU post-processing network and does NOT use ensembles; the adaptation uses five-seed frozen prediction disagreement + legal context features as the temperature inputs because AC-Twin's legal bundle carries seed-level consequence predictions, not BEV maps.

works.sanity_evidence: phase_l/sanity/sanity_report.json: CCTR_DRIVING_CALIBRATION_ADAPTED PASS (calibrated NLL 0.4193 < constant 0.4227, Spearman=0.330)

works.title: Regression with Reject Option and Application to kNN
works.authors: Ahmed Zaoui, Christophe Denis, Mohamed Hebiri
works.original_task: Optimal regression rejection by thresholding a plug-in conditional-variance estimate under a fixed rejection rate.
works.original_outputs: kNN regressor plus rejection rule from estimated conditional variance.
works.reason: Same family as P3; the frozen candidate table assigns the regression-with-rejection slot to Li et al. 2024 (P3), the newer consistent no-rejection-learning route.

selection_rules_frozen: plan section 3.3: exclude non-finite/degenerate/leaky candidates, then lowest validation AURC_REGRET, tie-break by REGRET@80, params, inference time, lexicographic id; STRONGEST_PUBLISHED_BASELINE = unique lowest-validation-AURC eligible method, never swapped after freeze.
